title: "Validating Input and Preconditions"
---

# Validating Input and Preconditions

Always validate preconditions before executing destructive actions:

```bash
# Validate argument count
[[ $# -ge 2 ]] || { echo "Usage: $0 <src> <dest>" >&2; exit 1; }

# Validate file existence and permissions
[[ -f "$1" ]] || { echo "Error: File $1 does not exist" >&2; exit 2; }
[[ -r "$1" ]] || { echo "Error: File $1 is not readable" >&2; exit 3; }
```
